diagram_previews.alt: A small circle with centre O and a large circle with centre A, joined by a dashed segment of length 26. A blue common external tangent segment above both circles is labelled 6 sqrt 17, and a red internal tangent segment crossing between the circles is labelled 4 sqrt 22. Gray radii run to the four points of tangency.
